description: Android Fragment class 'HomeFragment' managing UI components, map view, weather updates, and job count for a driver app.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment handling UI, map, weather, and job data for driver app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes UI components, map view, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: numberOfJobs

methods.description: Returns current date formatted as 'EEEE dd MMMM'.
